                    ## Add Performance Monitoring Endpoints

### Objective
To introduce new API endpoints for performance monitoring, enabling administrators to initiate and terminate Py-spy recordings, generating SVG files for visualization.

- Create a new module `codx.junior.monitoring`.
- Implement a class within `codx.junior.monitoring` to manage monitoring.

- `CODX_JUNIOR_STATIC_FOLDER` environment variable must be set for the image directory path.

## Integrate Performance Monitoring Endpoints into FastAPI Application

### Objective
To integrate the newly developed `PerformanceMonitor` class and its associated API endpoints (`/performance/start-monitoring` and `/performance/end-monitoring`) into the main FastAPI application. This integration will enable administrators to control Py-spy performance recordings directly through the API.

### Requirements
- Add the `PerformanceMonitor` class and its endpoints to the FastAPI application.
- Ensure the `images/monitoring` directory exists, creating it if necessary.
- Configure the application to use `CODX_JUNIOR_STATIC_FOLDER` for the monitoring output path.
- Implement robust error handling for Py-spy availability, file creation, and directory existence issues.
- Verify that the `/performance/start-monitoring` endpoint is accessible only to admin users.
- Verify that the `/performance/end-monitoring` endpoint is accessible only to admin users.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The `PerformanceMonitor` class is successfully initialized and registered with the FastAPI application.
- [ ] The `/performance/start-monitoring` endpoint is functional and accessible only to admin users.
- [ ] The `/performance/end-monitoring` endpoint is functional and accessible only to admin users.
- [ ] Initiating monitoring via `/performance/start-monitoring` correctly starts a Py-spy recording and saves an SVG file with a timestamped name in the `images/monitoring` directory.
- [ ] Terminating monitoring via `/performance/end-monitoring` correctly stops the Py-spy recording.
- [ ] The `images/monitoring` directory is created if it does not exist.
- [ ] Appropriate error messages are returned for scenarios such as:
    - Py-spy not being installed.
    - Failure to create the monitoring output directory.
    - Attempting to start monitoring when a recording is already in progress.
    - Attempting to end monitoring when no recording is active.
- [ ] All admin-only access controls are functioning as expected.

### Additional Notes
- Ensure `py-spy` is installed in the project environment.
- The `CODX_JUNIOR_STATIC_FOLDER` environment variable must be set correctly to define the base path for static files, including the `images/monitoring` directory.
- The current process ID (PID) will be obtained using `os.getpid()`.

**Keywords:** FastAPI Integration, Performance Monitoring, Py-spy, API Endpoints, Admin Access, SVG Generation, Error Handling.
